plugin.smooth_tip:
Smoothing – how even the bar grid becomes.
0 %: off. The bars stay as beat_this hears them – including bars of only 1 to 3 beats at unsure places.
Further right: the even grid may move more and more of beat_this's '1's – first only unsure ones, the further right, the surer ones.
100 %: the grid decides alone. It starts anew only where beat_this hears the '1' elsewhere over several bars (e.g. after an edit).
Default: 90 %. The beats themselves never change.
